annotation.title_clean: Die Kommission veröffentlicht Leitlinien zur Definition von KI-Systemen, um die Anwendung der Vorschriften des ersten KI-Gesetzes zu erleichtern
annotation.title_en: The Commission publishes guidelines on the definition of AI systems to facilitate application of the first rules of the AI Act
annotation.summary_en: European Commission web page announcing the February 2025 non-binding guidelines on the definition of an AI system under the EU AI Act, issued alongside guidelines on prohibited practices. It links to the guideline texts in many languages and notes the first AI Act rules applied from 2 February 2025.
key_provisions_or_claims: Guidelines clarify the AI Act's legal concept of an AI system for providers and others.
The guidelines are non-binding and will be updated as practical experience develops.
Published alongside guidelines on prohibited AI practices.
First AI Act rules apply since 2 February 2025: AI system definition, AI literacy, limited prohibitions.
AI Act classifies AI systems into risk categories: prohibited, high-risk, transparency.
